author: Seung Wook
problem: donations lists the money a school bake sale raised on each day, starting with day 0. Return the first day by which the total raised so far had reached the goal, or -1 if it never did.
bug_description: Checks raised == goal instead of raised >= goal, so a day that takes the total past the goal without landing on it exactly is missed.

comments.accurate: First day the running total reached the goal, or -1
comments.wrong_behavior: Day the takings hit the goal amount, or -1 if they never do
comments.wrong_location: Goal check verified; check the running total is updated before it is compared
